design-md.title: DESIGN.md, the Design Brief Agents Can Read

directions.name: Standfirst Press

type.body: Source Serif 4 400 (standfirst and reading), 600 for lead-ins
type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 18px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 6vw + 1rem, 6rem), h2 52px, lead 22px
type.tracking: display -0.01em (condensed heavy: never past -0.015em), body 0, labels 0 sentence case

shape.borders: one heavy 4px ink rule over 1px hairlines; rules separate, boxes never contain

directions.spacing: 8px base (4/8/12/16/24/40/64/96/144); sections 144/176px mixed at 1440, 96px under 60rem; prose measure 62ch

motion.character: still: only state moves (a green underline grows under a link over 220ms)

directions.signature: Condensed 800 grotesk heads over a serif standfirst, separated by a single 4px ink rule: the head, the rule and the standfirst do all the work, no ornament
doNot: round any corner
use the green on more than ~5% of a screen (links, one button, active nav)
add cards or drop shadows: paper has none
italicise one word in a head
set labels in tracked caps above heads

directions.name: Morning Broadsheet

type.body: Spectral 400, 18px, italic only in running prose
type.mono: Libre Franklin 600 tabular as agate for listed figures (not mono)
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 18px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5rem), h2 44-52px, agate 14px

shape.borders: 1px column rules between columns, 3px double rule for major breaks, hairline under each story

directions.spacing: 8px base; dense: sections 96/120px, column gap 32px with a centred 1px rule; 3-column justified text with hyphens:auto at 1440

motion.character: still: a link underline thickens on hover, nothing reveals or counts

directions.signature: Justified multi-column body under hairline column rules and a double rule masthead; brick red is a signal that never fills a surface
doNot: fill buttons or bands with the brick red
justify without hyphens: auto
use rounded cards or photos in colour (print them grayscale with a caption)
set more than 3 columns below 1280px

directions.name: Swiss Field

type.scale: 1.5 ratio (jumps of 3-4 steps), 16px body, h1 clamp(3.5rem, 8vw, 8rem), h2 56px, figures at poster scale

shape.borders: no strokes: structure comes from column lines and flat colour fields

directions.spacing: 8px base; 12-col grid, 32px gutters; type hung from column lines; sections 120/176px, white held on purpose

motion.character: still: a link turns red, a poster-scale value swaps in place

directions.signature: Full-palette posture: ultramarine floods whole fields (30-50% of a screen), one Swiss red #E2231A (dark mode #FF5A4F) marks the single chosen thing; heads hang from column lines, never centred
doNot: centre heads
add borders or shadows to fields
use the red on more than one element per screen
use a third colour
set body text on the ultramarine in grey

directions.name: Keycap Precision

type.mono: JetBrains Mono 400 (code and machine values only)
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5.25rem), h2 52px, counts 60px+ in display face
type.tracking: display -0.028em, body 0, labels 0 in Familjen 500 a step smaller (never mono)

shape.radius: 6px inputs / 8px panels; cut corners (16px bevel) on panels where corner-shape is supported
shape.borders: 1px hairline edges every surface and splits every row

directions.spacing: 8px base; ASCII/dot field on an 8x16 cell; sections 120/144px; code panels 24-32px padding

motion.character: brisk: keys lift 1px on hover, sink 3px on press in 120ms; connectors draw once

directions.signature: Buttons are keycaps with a real 3px bottom edge; code runs on a graphite panel (#1B2130) with one syntax tint, never a rainbow
doNot: use a warm accent or gradient button
fake code: snippets must run (use example.com)
set labels or nav in mono
put more than one graphite band per page plus one in the hero
draw a browser chrome around screenshots

directions.name: Phosphor Shell
avoidFor: anything where mono would be costume

type.mono: same family: every glyph is mono
type.scale: 1.2 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.25rem, 4vw + 1rem, 4rem), h2 36-40px

shape.borders: 1px rules in border colour; panels by lightness step (3 steps of ground)

directions.spacing: 8px base on a character grid (1ch columns); sections 96/120px; code blocks full container width

motion.easing: steps(1) for state, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for the one reveal
motion.character: severe: a session types itself once (22ms/char), caret blinks max 5 beats then solid

directions.signature: The hero IS a real command and its real output, typed once; a dim wash of the phosphor marks added/selected lines like a diff
doNot: add CRT scanlines, flicker or glow
invent output a command would not print
loop the typing
use a second hue besides the phosphor and an error red

directions.name: Dusk Ledger

type.mono: Geist Mono 400 for amounts in tables (or tabular-nums in body)
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 4.5vw + 1rem, 4.75rem), h2 48px, hero figure 72-96px tabular

shape.borders: 1px hairlines; tables with horizontal rules only
shape.shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(23,27,38,.05); one product panel may be smoked (surface at 88% + 1px lighter top edge)

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 120/144px; table rows 56-64px; amounts right-aligned to the decimal

motion.character: calm: product rows rise once staggered 40ms; bars grow from their feet when seen

directions.signature: A real photograph of land at dusk behind the hero with the product in one smoked panel beside the head; apricot #F2A66B (as a fill with ink text; #A65A1C as text in light mode) is reserved for the single 'needs attention' state
doNot: use green-up/red-down as the only signal
show trend arrows or figures nobody gave
stack 4 KPI cards as the hero
go neon on dark
use backdrop-blur on more than the one product panel

directions.name: Instrument Panel

type.body: Host Grotesk 400 / 500, 14px in tables, 16px in forms and prose
type.mono: Atkinson Hyperlegible Mono 400 for measured values, IDs, timestamps
type.scale: 1.125-1.2 fixed app scale: 12/14/16/18/22/28px, no clamp()
type.tracking: titles -0.015em, table heads 0 sentence case (never caps), body 0

shape.borders: 1px borders on panels; tables use row rules only, no outer box
shape.shadow: none; dark mode elevation is +3% lightness per level

directions.spacing: 4px base (4/8/12/16/24/32); controls 32-40px with 44px hit area; panel padding 16-24px; region gap 24px

motion.character: brisk: values change when their source does, nothing orchestrated, no load reveal

directions.signature: Amber means a person acted, cool blue #3E6FB0 (dark mode #7FA6E0) means an instrument measured: two meanings on one neutral graphite/grey ground, and the one object the tool is known by (the queue, the ledger, the timeline) leads the screen
doNot: open with a greeting over 4 stat cards
use cards where a table fits
draw only the full state (also loading skeleton, empty, error)
add a sidebar for fewer than ~7 destinations
put icons in coloured coins

directions.name: Stationery Desk

type.mono: Geist Mono 400 for figures and amounts
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5rem), h2 48-52px

shape.borders: 1px warm hairlines; records drawn as paper sheets with real edges
shape.shadow: letterpress: 0 1px 0 rgba(31,27,25,.06), 0 2px 6px -2px rgba(31,27,25,.10) (no border under it)

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 120/144px; cards 32px padding; split heroes 6fr/5fr

motion.character: calm: the product's one job plays once on the desk (~6s), then stills; paused off-screen

directions.signature: Records are stationery (sheets, envelopes, index cards lit from the left) and coral is pressed into the stock only for the one 'settled' state (paid, booked, done)
doNot: pair this with a high-contrast serif (that is the cream-serif-clay AI look)
spread coral past one control and one state per screen
make it skeuomorphic toy-like (no stitching, no leather)
use 3 icon feature tiles

directions.name: Lamplit Console

type.display: Newsreader 400 at opsz 72, set all lowercase, one step larger than usual
type.mono: Geist Mono 400 for streamed output, prompts and code
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 5.5vw + 1rem, 6rem), h2 56px

shape.borders: 1px hairline wells, faint blueprint grid behind the product only

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 144/176px; the product panel 7 of 12 columns, 560px+ tall

motion.character: one reveal: a streamed answer types once and the verb's underline draws in; otherwise state only

directions.signature: The product is the picture: a real prompt and a real streamed answer in the hero; warmth rationed to molten brass and one rose verb (#E68FA6 dark, #A8385A light) on a cool violet-black
doNot: put an orb, sparkle icon or glowing gradient blob anywhere
use purple-to-blue gradients
add glass cards
animate breathing light or ambient loops
write 'unlock', 'supercharge' or 'AI-powered' copy

directions.name: Midnight Instrument

type.display: Mona Sans 300 at wdth 125 (expanded, like film titles)
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 6vw + 1rem, 6rem), h2 52px

shape.borders: surfaces in lightness steps of the blue, hairlines rare

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 144/176px; Poster hero 92-100dvh

motion.character: calm: one settle, hero text 0.6 to 1 opacity over 520ms from visible; hover steps a surface one lightness up

directions.signature: Midnight blue to every edge (no black), photographs treated as moonlight (shadows in the ground's blue, highlights in the ink), expanded-light titles like a film credit
doNot: use pure black or neon
add frosted glass
slide or loop anything
light sections inside the dark build
add a second hue besides azure

directions.name: Safelight

type.display: Sofia Sans Extra Condensed 200-300, uppercase hairline capitals
type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 17px body, h1 clamp(4rem, 10vw, 9rem) line-height 1.0, h2 64px

shape.borders: hairlines only; photographs are plates on the ground, no frames
shape.shadow: none; fine light grain (2-3% opacity) on the ground

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 120/176px; plates up to 10 of 12 columns

motion.character: still as a print: a photograph may rise once from the ground over 420ms; a linked plate's number turns amber on hover

directions.signature: Black-and-white photographs printed deeper than a warm-black ground (so they sit as objects), with one amber safelight colour for links and the plate number
doNot: add film-strip or sprocket-hole costume
use pure #000 ground
colour photographs
use more than 45% of the page as photographs below the hero
track caps labels at small sizes

directions.name: Slow Light

type.body: Figtree 400 in a soft grey ink, 17px
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 17px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5rem), h2 48px

shape.borders: hairline rules instead of boxes

directions.spacing: 8px base; generous: sections 144/176px, 40px card padding, max 70 words per screen

motion.character: slow and breathing: levels ease, never jump; one ambient canvas at 8s+ per cycle, paused off-screen

directions.signature: Light-weight tight heads over a machined control that really sets something (a timer, a level, a sound mix), with the hour drawn as slow light behind it; dark mode is the night version of the same page
doNot: draw stars, moons or lotus illustrations
use sage-green-and-beige wellness cliché
use bouncy easing
run more than one loop
write 'journey' or 'elevate' copy

directions.name: Daylight Dose

type.mono: DM Mono 400 for times and doses only, set like a pharmacy label
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 17px body (older readers), h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5rem), h2 48px

shape.borders: soft tinted plastic bands instead of borders

directions.spacing: 8px base; controls 48-52px (coarse pointers, older users); sections 120/144px

motion.character: calm: once in view a label rises and a tick lands; window light drifts over 90s, paused off-screen

directions.signature: Doses and times set in DM Mono like a pharmacy label inside translucent tinted bands (like a pill organiser); one pharmacy green does every signal
doNot: use clinical blue-white hospital styling
use stock doctor photos
rely on red/green alone for taken/missed
put mono on anything but times and doses
show invented outcome statistics

directions.name: Cut Paper

type.body: Andika 400 / 700 (built for beginning readers: single-storey a and g), 18px
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 18px body, line-height 1.6, h1 clamp(3rem, 6vw + 1rem, 5.5rem), h2 48px

shape.radius: 14px cards / 12px controls; one torn paper edge per page
shape.borders: none; sheets of paper with a pale fibre core where torn
shape.shadow: card stock: 0 4px 0 0 #1B2340 on buttons (press to 1px), 0 2px 0 rgba(27,35,64,.12) on cards

directions.spacing: 8px base; chunky: controls 52-56px, 24px gaps, sections 96/120px

motion.easing: spring cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) on the primary only; snap cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) elsewhere
motion.character: playful: one word pops in its accent and a sprout grows; never scale() bounces on everything

directions.signature: Full palette with jobs: pear #CDE85A = action (ink text), blue #2F5BD3 = links (dark mode #8FA8FF), coral #F0624D = one loud moment (fill with ink text), mint = growth; all on grained cream cut paper
doNot: use Comic-style faces
use emoji as icons
draw mascots or clip-art illustrations
set pear text on cream (pear is a fill with ink text and a 2px ink edge; contrast 1.3:1 on bg)
bounce more than the primary and one moment

directions.name: Night Cabinet

type.display: Bungee 400 capitals, RGB split by 1-2px text-shadow on the hero line only
type.mono: Silkscreen 400 for scores, timers and figures (pixel outlier, one role)
type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem) line-height 1.0, h2 52px

shape.borders: 2px ink edges on controls

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 96/120px; key art Poster hero 92-100dvh

motion.easing: steps(1) for cursor/selection, cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) for press
motion.character: severe press physics; a cursor row lights in one frame, no fades

directions.signature: Aubergine CRT ground with two inks taking turns like two players: ember #FF7A2E and acid #C6FF3D (acid is a fill with ink text only); key art or trailer is the hero, store buttons right under the head
doNot: go synthwave (no purple-pink gradients, no grid horizon)
draw pixel-art props
add CRT flicker
use more than two signal inks
make the page longer than 5-6 blocks

directions.name: Die-Cut Sticker

type.display: Bowlby One SC 400 (small caps by design)
type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem) line-height 1.02, h2 52px

shape.borders: 4px white die-cut border around every raised surface

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 96/120px; tiles 24-32px padding

motion.character: sticker physics: hover lifts a clickable sticker 2px and turns it 1deg; press pushes it onto its shadow

directions.signature: Every raised surface is a die-cut sticker: thick white edge on a hard ink offset, filled flat in hot pink #EE4C84 or lime #B8E62E, always with ink #1D1A17 type (never white on pink)
doNot: blur shadows
tint fills (they are solid)
stamp sticker pills on every element
rotate non-interactive things
use pastel versions of the inks

directions.name: Raw Poster

type.scale: 1.414 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3.5rem, 9vw, 9rem) line-height 1.0, h2 56-64px
type.tracking: display -0.02em (caps, line-height >= 1.0 when it can wrap), body 0

shape.borders: 3px ink rules; cells share their rules so the grid is drawn, not implied

directions.spacing: 8px base; boxed cells 24-40px padding; sections join edge to edge at the rule (no gaps) or 120px open air

motion.character: nothing glides: a cell inverts to ink or fills yellow under its ink on hover

directions.signature: A drawn grid of 3px rules with one word or number set huge inside a box as the ornament; acid yellow only ever fills (never text on paper)
doNot: set yellow text on the light ground (fails contrast: yellow is a fill)
round anything
add soft shadows or gradients
use default system fonts as 'brutal'
go dark-hacker by default

directions.name: Fighting Red

type.display: Anton 400 capitals at poster size, leaded tight
type.scale: 1.5 ratio, 17px body, h1 clamp(4rem, 10vw, 9rem) line-height 1.0, claims 40-56px

shape.borders: hairlines plus one heavy 12px ink bar per page

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections change paper edge to edge (bleed-ink / bleed-paper), 120px padding

motion.character: one clip reveal: the hero head wipes upward once via clip-path inset(), never a soft fade

directions.signature: Poster-size caps against a small quiet body; red is spent once per screen (the one action, or one red word in the hero only, stamped as the theme's exception)
doNot: pulse or animate the red
use red on more than one element per screen
invent statistics to sound urgent
tilt every head (one -2deg tilt max)

directions.name: Oat & Leaf

type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 17px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5.25rem), h2 52px

shape.borders: hairlines; soft moss (#DDE5D2) or clay (#EBDDCF) tinted wells, nothing boxed

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 120/144/176 mixed; photographs 4:5 portrait or 3:2 landscape, never cropped tiny

motion.character: still: a pill darkens one step, an underline grows

directions.signature: Every neutral leans green and the produce keeps its true daylight colour; a seasonal table (what is ready now) set in Vollkorn old-style figures
doNot: draw leaves, sprigs or veg illustrations
use sage-and-slate wellness styling
use a terracotta accent with a serif (AI cream-serif-clay look)
desaturate food photos

directions.name: Limewash Atelier

type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 6vw + 1rem, 6.5rem) line-height 1.05, h2 56px

shape.borders: 1px hairlines; prints matted with a 24-32px mat of surface colour

directions.spacing: 8px base; airy: sections 144/176/208px; product photos 4:5 at 520px+ tall

motion.character: calm: fade in after fonts load; sample strips unfurl once over 600ms

directions.signature: Matted, warm-daylight product prints on limewash paper; one cool slate signal nearly as dark as the umber ink (luxury through restraint, never gold)
doNot: use gold or a terracotta accent
put text over product photos
use more than one filled button
add sale badges, countdowns or urgency
use italic display flourishes on single words

directions.name: Proof Sheet

type.mono: Geist Mono 400 for redline measurements only
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.75rem, 5vw + 1rem, 5.25rem), h2 52px

shape.borders: 8px L-shaped crop marks at the corners of every printed piece; 1px cadmium construction guides and clear-space boxes
shape.shadow: none; faint ink dot grid (24px) and fine grain on the ground

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 120/144px; work shown at 8-12 columns

motion.character: guides draw in once along their length; state changes at 220ms

directions.signature: The work photographed in true colour inside crop marks, with cadmium orange redlines showing the system (metric guides, clear space): the studio's process is the ornament
doNot: show work as tiny thumbnails
add rotated vertical labels, scroll cues or city/weather strips
use a '01 / 06' counter on tiles
invent client logos or awards

directions.name: Cyanotype

type.mono: IBM Plex Mono 400 for measurements with units (12 mm, 4.2 kN)
type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.5rem, 4.5vw + 1rem, 4.75rem) line-height 1.04, h2 44px

shape.borders: square double keylines (1px, 3px gap, 1px) instead of cards; dimension strings with end ticks

directions.spacing: 8px base on a visible 8px drafting grid; sections 120/144px

motion.character: static, drafted: one dimension line draws itself once (scaleX from its left tick over 420ms)

directions.signature: Drenched Prussian-blue sheet where the white line is the only signal; photographs printed as cyanotypes (blue shadows, white highlights) and every figure carries its unit
doNot: add a second colour
use full-colour photos
draw decorative grids with nothing measured on them
use rounded cards or soft shadows

directions.name: Counter Notice

type.scale: 1.25 ratio, 16px body, h1 clamp(2.5rem, 4.5vw + 1rem, 4.5rem), h2 44px, listing title 20px

shape.borders: hairline rows; state pills outlined in 1px

directions.spacing: 8px base; dense lists: rows 64-88px, filters inline above results; sections 96/120px

motion.character: still: a filter applies as you type (250ms debounce), a pill changes state on click

directions.signature: A black with no hue on white, and one teal that means 'in / open / available': the listings themselves (with real facts in columns) are the page
doNot: show fake listings with real-looking prices or names
use the teal for anything but availability and the primary
hide filters in a sidebar on desktop by reflex
add counters or marquees

directions.name: Market Stall

type.scale: 1.333 ratio, 17px body, h1 clamp(3rem, 7vw, 7rem), price figures 96-144px

shape.borders: none; tiles a step lighter or deeper than the green

directions.spacing: 8px base; sections 96/120px; tiles 32px padding; product photos close and bright, 1:1 or 4:5

motion.character: quick, state only: a control presses 1px, a chosen tile rings at 220ms

directions.signature: Drenched forest-green ground (#173D27) to every edge with fruit photographed bright and close as the colour; a price or a day set huge in Gabarito; juicy peach controls
doNot: draw fruit illustrations
put grey text on the green
add a second accent hue
use more than one photograph-led section in a row
use peach as text or as a borderless button on the cream light mode (fill only, 2px #17321F edge)

sources.name: UI/UX Pro Max Skill
sources.gives: A searchable design database: 190+ product types mapped to styles, landing patterns and palettes, 70+ font pairings, 100+ UX rules and per-framework guidance. Bundled here and searchable with search_design_db.

sources.name: Awesome DESIGN.md
sources.gives: 70+ DESIGN.md files that document real products' design systems (Linear, Stripe, Vercel...). Fetched live by get_brand_reference.
install: Copy a design-md/<brand>/DESIGN.md into your repo

sources.name: Open Design
sources.gives: A local design workspace for agents (prototypes, sites, decks) plus a craft library: typography, colour, accessibility, state coverage, anti-slop rules. Its craft rules are condensed into the foundation guides.

sources.name: Taste Skill
sources.gives: Art direction, references and a visual check in the browser: tells, type, colour, layout, copy and critique references. Condensed into anti-slop and the foundation guides.

sources.name: Impeccable
sources.gives: Rules and commands to spot AI-looking UI and fix it, with a detector engine. Its patterns power audit_ui and the workflow guide.

sources.name: React Bits
sources.gives: 215+ animated React components (text, backgrounds, effects). Searchable with find_components.

sources.name: Skills for Designers and Engineers
sources.gives: Emil Kowalski's skills for animation and small UI details: easing, durations, origin-aware motion, edge cases. Condensed into motion and native-feel.

sources.name: Hallmark
sources.gives: Deals one of 48 themes, picks from 21 page shapes and runs hard checks in a real browser so pages don't look machine-made. Its themes, shapes and gates shape pick_direction, layouts and review.

sources.name: Google DESIGN.md
sources.gives: One file that describes a whole design system for agents, with a linter. write_design_md emits it.

sources.name: Magic UI
sources.gives: Animated components and effects you copy into your app via shadcn. Searchable with find_components.

sources.name: GSAP Skills
sources.gives: Official GreenSock skills: core, timelines, ScrollTrigger, React and performance. Condensed into gsap-scroll.

sources.name: Scroll World
sources.gives: One skill that turns a brand into a 3D fly-through landing page scrubbed by scroll (needs paid video-generation credits and ffmpeg). Summarised in gsap-scroll.

sources.name: Canvas UI
sources.gives: 35 WebGL and WebGPU effects running over real, clickable HTML, installed through a shadcn registry. Searchable with find_components.

sources.name: Dimensional Drawing
sources.gives: Turns a UI component into an Apple-style technical drawing with paddings, gaps and radii. Summarised in dimensional-drawing.
